task_description: GitHub issue #30: Rebalance the wide-screen (>=760px) two-column layout so the right column is no longer short with a large empty bottom-right gap (caused by #19 moving the chat UI into the left column). Move StatsPanel into the right column (left = sprite + chat, right = stats + care + battle) and preserve the #19 single-column (<760px) stacking order sprite -> chat -> stats -> care -> battle. Layout/CSS + JSX element placement only; no logic/i18n/dependency changes. Verify wide + narrow with Playwright. Frontend-only (orchestrator redeploys).

verification.summary: Root npm run build green. Shared tests 47/47, frontend ui-helpers 55/55 - both unchanged from baseline (pure layout change, as intended; no test code was added or needed). Playwright screenshots (30-wide-1280.png, 30-narrow-420.png) confirm: wide = two balanced columns with StatsPanel moved to the right column filling the former empty bottom-right gap, no overflow; narrow = single column in the preserved #19 order sprite->chat->stats->care->battle. test_quality: no new tests expected or added for a CSS/JSX-placement change; existing 55 helper tests remain green. No Dockerfile relevant for this frontend change.
